Markets.title: Retail algo trading gets a makeover: how APIs, AI and regulation are opening the door for Indian traders
Markets.summary: APIs, AI, and regulatory clarity are lowering technology barriers and formalizing retail algorithmic trading in India. However, experts warn that automation cannot replace robust strategies, thorough testing, and proper risk management.

Markets.title: Global Market: China state insurers, banks to raise up to $54 billion to bolster capital
Markets.summary: China's Ministry of Finance will inject up to $10.4 billion into five state-owned insurers to strengthen financial stability. This recapitalization is part of a broader plan by Chinese state insurers and banks to raise up to $54 billion to bolster their capital.

Markets.title: Is investing in stock market an art or science? What Peter Lynch says in 'One Up on Wall Street'
Markets.summary: Legendary investor Peter Lynch states that successful stock-picking relies on logic and company fundamentals rather than complex mathematics. In his book 'One Up on Wall Street,' he advises investors to ignore market predictions and conduct proper research to find potential tenbaggers.

Markets.title: SBICAP Securities partners with Appreciate for global market access via India INX GA, NSEIXGA
Markets.summary: SBICAP Securities has partnered with Appreciate Broking IFSC to provide retail investors in India with regulated access to over 8,000 US stocks and global ETFs through GIFT City. The platform features single-KYC onboarding and allows fractional investing starting at one dollar.

Markets.title: Midcap rally hides a deeper split: Every second stock down but index up 11% in 1 year. Are investors walking on thin ice?
Markets.summary: The Nifty Midcap 150 index rose 11% over the past year despite a 6% decline in the broader Nifty. However, more than half of the index's constituent stocks remain in the red, with some dropping up to 70%.

Markets.title: HDFC Bank shares fall 2% to fresh 52-week low despite victory in Credit Suisse AT1 bonds cases in Bahrain
Markets.summary: HDFC Bank shares dropped 2% to a new 52-week low even though courts in Bahrain dismissed all seven lawsuits related to Credit Suisse AT1 bonds. The stock continues to struggle due to ongoing governance concerns, recent financial losses, and shifting investor attention toward upcoming earnings reports.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have reportedly seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha. This capture brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which is a key shipping route.

Geo-Political.title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian strike on a shopping centre in the city centre of Pavlohrad killed five people and injured 67 others, according to Ukraine. Local media report that this attack is the third Russian strike on a mall within days.

Geo-Political.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
Geo-Political.summary: Flight data shows one pilot warned the other about the Amazon cargo plane's excessive speed before it crashed. Despite the warning and sounding alarms, the crew had an uneven response to the situation.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is suing a newspaper over a report claiming the UAE warned him about the 7 October attack. The newspaper stated it stands by its reporting, which was based on extracts from a new book.

Geo-Political.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
Geo-Political.summary: A French court jailed a father for threatening to behead a female primary school teacher. The incident occurred near Toulouse over a dispute involving his son.

Geo-Political.summary: A tourist coach carrying dozens of Dutch passengers overturned in the south-eastern Swiss Alps. The crash resulted in the deaths of several people.

Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation likely climbed to a 20-month high of 4.9% in August due to rising food prices. This increase is driven by ongoing risks from the West Asia war, pushing inflation further above the 4% medium-term target.

Data & Insights.summary: BRICS economic dynamics and trade data reveal significant export and import trends alongside a $226 billion trade deficit. These shifts, driven heavily by India's role, have the potential to challenge the dominance of the US dollar in global trade.

Data & Insights.title: IMF backs India's new GDP data, says updated IIP, PPI will improve accuracy
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF has endorsed India's statistical reforms, stating that updated IIP and PPI series will enhance GDP estimation accuracy. This support comes amid a political controversy in India where a former finance secretary questioned the methodology behind the country's 7.8% GDP growth figure.

Data & Insights.title: Russian President in New Delhi for BRICS Summit: What time is Modi-Putin meeting today? What’s on agenda
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Prime Minister Narendra Modi will hold bilateral talks in New Delhi on Friday afternoon during the BRICS Summit. Their discussions will focus on strategic trade, energy security, payment mechanisms, and geopolitical conflicts in Eastern Europe and West Asia.

Data & Insights.title: States are using a roundabout way to borrow. And that's raising concerns
Data & Insights.summary: States are increasingly borrowing money through special purpose vehicles and state corporations. This practice creates a false sense of financial responsibility while making the state government ultimately responsible for the debt.

Data & Insights.summary: Global leaders including Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Masoud Pezeshkian are attending the BRICS summit in New Delhi. Originally formed in 2006 by four countries, the alliance now includes eleven major emerging markets and developing nations.

India.title: Analysis | From Mayawati's Heir To Outcast: The Akash Anand Story
India.summary: Akash Anand has been removed as Mayawati's political heir amid a family feud within the Bahujan Samaj Party. This internal conflict highlights an intense ongoing struggle for control of the party.

India.summary: Police detained an army insider involved in the theft of weapons from a Hyderabad military base following a 10-day manhunt. The theft was uncovered on August 31 after a Lieutenant Colonel of the Madras Regiment filed a police complaint.

India.title: Bihar's Sattu, Odisha's Coffee And More: What's Inside BRICS Goodie Bag

India.summary: As the BRICS Chair for 2026, India will host the BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13. During the BRICS Business Forum, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar emphasized the need to boost economic security and build resilient supply chains.

India.summary: Eight people, including three children, died in a collision between a truck and a pickup van. The fatal road accident occurred early this morning in Maharashtra's Bhandara district.
